# Legacy / out-of-scope workflow files excluded from rethab/actions-lint@v1.0.0.
# The 2022 linter does not understand modern contexts (vars.*, concurrency inputs)
# and treats secrets.* in non-workflow_call workflows as undeclared.
# Do Not Under-Scope (WR-15860) allows exclusion patterns for legacy workflows.
# New workflow files must NOT be added here — they must pass actions-lint.
#
